milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when the player mines an acacia_log block with the iron axe, the acacia_log item drops and enters their inventory. The player starts with zero acacia_logs, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted acacia_door ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no acacia_door and there are none placed in the scene, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting. The recipe yields 3 doors per craft, but min_count=1 is sufficient. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
